item.title: Anthropic takes $5B from Amazon and pledges $100B in cloud spending in return
item.description:
📝 The deal echoes an agreement Amazon struck with OpenAI just two months ago, when it joined a $110 billion funding round — contributing $50 billion — that valued the ChatGPT maker at a $730 billion pre-money valuation. The Anthropic deal specifically covers Trainium2 through Trainium4 chips, even though Trainium4 chips are not currently available.
